# State Class View (variant): Rangeland management specialist (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Target levels are editorial design drafts. A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

- **Role:** Rangeland management specialist (`emst:forest/ROL-QM9BY8K`, P2); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.2.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (registered rule, status active), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Plan, authorize and monitor livestock grazing on shared rangelands — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Monitor rangeland condition with calibrated field indicators — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Describe, test and sample soils in the field — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — journey L2, senior L3
- Detect, treat and monitor invasive species in the field — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions — journey L2, senior L3
- Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands — journey L2, senior L3
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1, journey L2, senior L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1, senior L1
- Negotiate and administer land rights, rights-of-way and realty actions — entry L1, journey L2, senior L3
